title: Week 2
verification_note: Every line is DraftKings' own number, pulled through The Odds API (opening snapshot for Week 2, saved to lines/open-week-02.json). Best combined_edge anywhere on the 16-game board is +0.005 (Over 44.5, Jaguars at Broncos) -- nothing clears Rule A's +0.015 bar, so no early tickets this week. Watch list has the numbers to take if they move our way.
watch: Falcons +2.5 (now) -> take at +3.5 or better. Atlanta has not named a Week 2 starter (Tua Tagovailoa oblique, Michael Penix Jr. also banged up). If the public piles onto Carolina/Bryce Young off his big Week 1 and pushes this line further, the bigger number on Atlanta is the side worth a look.

Giants +7 (now) -> take at +7.5 or better. Rams DE Myles Garrett is headed to IR for knee surgery (minimum four games) and Aaron Donald's Week 2 availability is unresolved -- real pass-rush attrition for the Rams front heading into Monday night.

Vikings +5.5 (now) -> take at +6.5 or better. Carson Wentz replaces Kyler Murray (concussion protocol) on the road at Chicago, one week after the Bears put up 59 points in a shootout. If the market keeps pushing this number on the QB change, the bigger one is the side to grab.
